g.text: Selected work and authorization: see current.json · semantic dashboard owns the detailed view

a.xlink:title: Project completion requires supported and readable selected thesis claims, truthful code/data/reproduction and availability promises, a frozen candidate meeting the recorded human PASS threshold, required delivery/archive dispositions, and released assignments. This map does not assert any present whole-project readiness. blocker: Workflow implementation/acceptance, thesis source/support/human PASS, code/evidence and reproduction checks, actual delivery/archive dispositions and final session release remain unfinished. plan_gap: Whole-thesis PASS and other thesis/project completion obligations remain unresolved. Current selected work is only review and repair of the rejected two-page opening. project: msc-math authorization: Jörn explicitly restarted from fe3475b3 on 4 October 2026: best supported thesis PDF/repository using remaining weekly quota (numeric balance unknown), no human questions, absolute stop 2026-10-04T02:00:00Z. No public release or university submission. next_step: Finish root review of the bounded opening candidate; separately select future work for remaining obligations. Sources: meta-topics/project-management/thesis-work.md, meta-topics/project-management/handoff.md, docs/project-facts.md, meta-topics/repository-organization/README.md

Selected project-local skills and workflow deliverables integrated and working against the agreed support contract, with evidence and caveats retained; all assignments closed and their sessions released. Plans alone do not establish readiness. The bounded thesis restart is complete; workflow migration remains unselected. blocker: Selected completion package and acceptance criteria are not agreed; delivery, acceptance and session release remain unfinished. project: workflows authorization: Only the recorded selected assignment is authorized; future activation/execution remains separately selected. next_step: Select the reviewed local migration and acceptance package; workflow readiness is one subproject, not whole-project completion. Remaining outcome is unresolved. project: workflows authorization: Only the recorded selected assignment is authorized; future activation/execution remains separately selected. next_step: Present the concise recommendation and capability gaps directly in chat; then mark proposal delivery done and retain any actual unanswered choice without claiming receipt/approval. No further root execution or invented approval question selected at closure. Permanent/all-agent coverage, native export deduplication, active-work/task joins and quota/billing conversion remain unestablished. Technical artifacts are retained without a PASS/readiness claim. project: workflows authorization: Jörn requested checking available scripts and applicable other-session ownership for passive resource attribution. Bounded read-only observation and correction of an attribution grouping defect; no quota experiment, new service or budget enforcement selected. Follow-up bounded readiness review covers discoverability, automation, session-log attribution, trust and fork behavior; it does not activate a new service, hook, skill, goal or quota experiment. Jörn explicitly instructed fixing the reproduced defects at 21:13 UTC on 3 October. Reporting at task start/handoff was rejected; no automatic delivery mechanism was approved. Jörn explicitly objected to stopping with incomplete work at 21:25 UTC and directed continued workflow completion, allowing a specific question/blocker when necessary. Bounded implementation and delivery investigation continue; config approval boundary remains. Completion is scoped to the original local script-readiness/fork/discoverability/interpretation questions and subsequent supervised ongoing-work observation; no broader service, scientific run or spending selected. next_step: Existing Fix orchestration owner receives the failed-attempt result and Jörn’s objection to giving up; no assignment transfer, extra spending or cancellation inferred from sending this report.
